description: The slow-photons page reports an experiment in which spatially structured photons, single photons included, arrived later than unstructured ones in free space, and that its authors attribute the delay to a lower axial group velocity from the light's structure, not to a violation of special relativity.
limitations: Recorded as the page reports it. The cited paper (arXiv 1411.3987) was not opened for this record.

sources.quote: Researchers found that spatially structured photons arrived later than their unstructured counterparts.
